cost.note: Optional project spend guardrail. The coordinator estimates spend as sum over workers of (blended $/1M of the role's model) x (est_tokens_per_worker / 1M), logged in .pmos/log.md. If the running estimate exceeds max_project_cost_usd, the coordinator STOPS and asks the user to raise the cap, cut roles, or downgrade models. The user can override the cap per project at GATE 1.

embeddings.note: Offline by default: deterministic local hashing vectors. For real embeddings set env vars PMOS_EMBEDDINGS_URL (OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint), PMOS_EMBEDDINGS_KEY, PMOS_EMBEDDINGS_MODEL, then run 'kb.py reindex-vectors'.
